description: Figure 6 (left) is a pie chart titled “Distribution of data source in the combined training set,” which visually represents the proportional contribution of various data sources to the combined training set. The chart is divided into multiple colored segments, each labeled with the name of a data source and its corresponding percentage. The largest segment is labeled “NQ” and accounts for 31.3% of the total. Other significant segments include “TRIVIAQA” at 22.7%, “SNLI” at 15.4%, “VITAMINC” at 13.0%, and “XSUMHUL” at 1.8%. Smaller segments are labeled “SCIFACT” (4.6%), “FEVER” (1.6%), “ANLI” (2.6%), “TREC” (1.9%), “MULTIFC” (0.5%), “PUBHEALTH” (0.5%), “MULTINLI” (11.3%), “SCITAIL” (1.2%), and “ENTFA” (0.1%). Each slice is clearly demarcated by color and has a line extending from it to its label, and the percentages are explicitly written within or adjacent to the respective slices. The chart does not appear to have a legend, and no slices are visually emphasized (e.g., exploded or bolded). The segments are arranged in a clockwise order, starting from the top, with no apparent descending or ascending size order.
